new_official_source_inspection.name: torch.nn.functional.softmax
new_official_source_inspection.short_excerpt:
def softmax(
    input: Tensor,
    dim: int | None = None,
    _stacklevel: int = 3,
    dtype: DType | None = None,
) -> Tensor:
    r"""Apply a softmax function.

    Softmax is defined as:

    :math:`\text{Softmax}(x_{i}) = \frac{\exp(x_i)}{\sum_j \exp(x_j)}`

    It is applied to all slices along dim, and will re-scale them so that the elements
    lie in the range `[0, 1]` and sum to 1.

    See :class:`~torch.nn.Softmax` for more details.

softmax_order_derivation: For finite logits z_i, p_i=exp(z_i)/sum_j exp(z_j). The denominator is positive and common to all i, and exp is strictly increasing, so an argmax logit is also a maximum-probability token. Ties remain valid maxima; installed argmax documents selecting the first maximal index. This is an algebraic derivation, not a training experiment. The separate executed trace checks logits/probability maxima on the actual row.
